title: Chapter 2734: Karma Obelisk
content:
Chapter 2734: Karma Obelisk

"If you want me to support Xu Jiaqi, then that’s what I’ll do," Qiang Qing Yun said after a moment of silence. "I still owe you for saving my life, after all."

Although she had intended to become the next leader of the Celestial Overlords, it wasn’t out of ambition. Rather, she simply wanted to protect something that had once belonged to someone precious to her because she thought the others were trying to ruin it.

However, now that the founder of the faction had returned, Qiang Qing Yun no longer had any reason to fight for the top position.

"What do you know about the other two Celestial Overlords?" Yuan asked a moment later.

"Liu Yucang and Bi Ao? What do you want to know about them?"

"Everything you know."

"Then not much. Bi Ao was already part of the faction before I joined, and he’s extremely secretive. However, he currently has the most support within the faction, with roughly forty percent of its members on his side."

"As for Liu Yucang, he has a rough and arrogant personality. In terms of influence, he’s the weakest in the faction. However, he’s been aggressively trying to increase his influence recently by forming alliances with other factions."

"Do you know why they’re trying to take control of the faction?" Yuan then asked.

Qiang Qing Yun shook her head.

"Although I don’t know their motives, I doubt it’s anything good. Even though the faction is in a mess internally, it’s still one of the most powerful factions in the Nine Heavens, and being its leader will obviously have plenty of perks."

After a brief pause, Qiang Qing Yun asked, "Are you going to deal with them?"

Yuan raised an eyebrow and replied, "No, not unless they do something that warrants it. I may have founded the Celestial Overlords, but my era passed long ago. At this point, I consider myself nothing more than an observer."

"So you have no intention of returning to the Celestial Overlords...?" Qiang Qing Yun mumbled dispiritedly, having expected him to reclaim his position as their leader.

Yuan quietly shook his head.

"..."

After a moment of silence, Qiang Qing Yun asked, "If you’re going to abandon it so easily, why did you create the Celestial Overlords in the first place?"

Yuan didn’t immediately respond, and a pondering expression appeared on his face.

"Quite frankly, I don’t remember."

"Huh?" Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened as she stared at him in disbelief.

"I still have some memories that have yet to return," he explained.

"I-Is that so..."

"Anyways, before I leave, I’d like to use the Karma Obelisk," Yuan said a moment later.

"Why?" Qiang Qing Yun questioned, her eyebrows raised in puzzlement.

"I’m curious about something."

"Alright..."

Qiang Qing Yun led Yuan to the Karma Obelisk, which stood in the middle of a large, open plaza.

The obelisk was roughly twenty meters tall and appeared to be carved entirely from white jade.

There were names engraved on the obelisk, with Qiang Qing Yun and the other Celestial Overlords’ names at the top.

"Xu Jiaqi is first, huh?" Yuan muttered after seeing her name sitting above everyone else.

"Although she has a cold personality and often comes across as distant, no one in the faction can deny how much effort she puts into it," Qiang Qing Yun said.

She turned to face Yuan and continued, "So, what are you curious about?"

Without responding, Yuan approached the Karma Obelisk and placed a hand on it.

The obelisk immediately began glowing, and soon, a number appeared at the very top.

"?!?!" Qiang Qing Yun’s eyes widened in disbelief.

"That’s impossible!" she cried out after rubbing her eyes and confirming that she was seeing things clearly.

The next moment, the names engraved on the obelisk began to shift, each one moving down a position. Then, at the very top—even above Xu Jiaqi’s name—Yuan’s name appeared.

"What is going on?! Did you do something to the obelisk?!" She turned to ask Yuan.

"No, I didn’t do anything to it. The Karma Obelisk isn’t something that can be manipulated, either."

"Then how...?"

A look of realization suddenly flashed across Qiang Qing Yun’s face, and she said, "Don’t tell me that you were lying about being responsible for our karma dropping?!"

She believed that Yuan had lied about being the perpetrator, as that was the only logical explanation.

"No, that really was me. I clashed with Heaven’s Mandate and killed many of their soldiers. I suppose what I did afterward earned me enough karma to recover everything I lost and then some."

"What did you do...? And when? As far as I’m aware, our faction’s ranking hasn’t changed. However, if you truly recovered all the karma we lost, we would’ve noticed immediately—"

Qiang Qing Yun suddenly stopped mid-sentence when she felt her communication jade slip tremble.

She instinctively reached for it and listened to the message she had just received.

"Celestial Overlord Qiang! You won’t believe this, but not only has our faction regained our old ranking, but it’s even risen by four ranks! We’re ranked third in the Karma Ranking now!"

"..."

Qiang Qing Yun fell silent after hearing the message, her eyes shifting back to the Karma Obelisk.

"H-How?" Qiang Qing Yun asked Yuan again a moment later.

However, Yuan remained silent with a mysterious smile on his face.

’Looks like killing all those demons had an effect on my karma,’ Yuan thought inwardly.

Just like killing exiles and criminals, killing demons also granted karma. In fact, demons were among the most rewarding targets for gaining karma due to how difficult they were to kill, and during the Divine Paragon’s banquet, Yuan had slain thousands of them.

As for why the rankings hadn’t updated until Yuan touched the Karma Obelisk, it was likely because he had accumulated so much karma at once that the system needed additional time to calculate and register it.

"If you don’t want to tell me, don’t," Qiang Qing Yun began speaking again a moment later. "However, I must warn you that this won’t fix your situation, as it won’t revert what you’ve done to Heaven’s Mandate, and you’re still being hunted by them."
